_about: James Bannerman (1807-1868), professor at New College, Edinburgh (Free Church of Scotland): The Church of Christ, a treatise on the nature, powers, ordinances, discipline and government of the Christian Church, ed. his son D. D. Bannerman (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1868, 2 vols), and Inspiration: the Infallible Truth and Divine Authority of the Holy Scriptures (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1865). Volume numbers read off the title pages. Named james-bannerman so his son cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
